title: anon keeps EXECUTE on all eight RPCs and full column grants on all six swap tables; join_swap_group is an unauthenticated invite-code oracle
where: supabase/migrations/001_swap_board.sql:82-83, 166-167, 266-267, 283-284, 300-301, 338-339 (revoke ... from public) and :68-69 (grants with no preceding revoke); live-verified via has_function_privilege and information_schema.column_privileges
detail: Supabase's default privileges grant anon and authenticated ALL on new tables and EXECUTE on new functions at creation time; `revoke ... from public` does not touch those explicit role grants. Live: anon can EXECUTE all eight RPCs and holds SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE on every column of all six tables -- including swap_posts.author, swap_match_legs.leg_user, swap_matches.proposed_by and swap_members.user_id; authenticated additionally holds UPDATE on swap_groups and swap_members that the migration never granted. RLS is enabled on all six and every policy is `to authenticated`, so anon is denied at the row level today and the stray UPDATEs have no policy. The one live consequence: join_swap_group as anon runs the definer lookup and then `insert into swap_members(..., auth.uid())` hits the NOT NULL constraint -- a real code returns 23502, a wrong one returns P0001 'invalid_code'. That is an unauthenticated, unrate-limited oracle over the code space (32^6 ~= 1.07e9 with the client alphabet at index.html:1592) -- impractical to sweep today, but the code is the board's only secret and the check costs nothing. docs/swap-board.md's "author ... is 403 for everyone" holds only for authenticated; one future `to public`/`to anon` policy (a public-preview feature, say) would hand the whole author column to the anon key. The doc's statement that the 16 advisor WARNs "are the design" contradicts the migration's own revoke.
failure: A script holding only the public anon key can confirm which 6-character codes are live boards without ever signing up, then sign up any email and join; and the anonymity columns are one mistaken policy away from being readable with the anon key.
fix: New migration 004: `revoke all on public.swap_posts, public.swap_matches, public.swap_match_legs, public.swap_members, public.swap_groups, public.swap_profiles from anon;` `revoke execute on function public.join_swap_group(text), public.swap_board(uuid), public.propose_swap(uuid,uuid[]), public.decline_swap_match(uuid), public.match_details(uuid), public.reveal_match(uuid), public.is_swap_member(uuid), public.is_match_party(uuid) from anon;` `revoke update on public.swap_groups, public.swap_members from authenticated;` and in join_swap_group open with `if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'invalid_code'; end if;` so both outcomes read identically. Re-run the advisor: the 8 anon WARNs should disappear. Update docs/swap-board.md accordingly.
